title: ‘The Testaments’ Has a Major ‘The Handmaid’s Tale’ Connection — But You Won’t See Any Red (At Least Not in Season One)
summary: "I had déjà vu all over again with Chase [Infiniti] sitting at the window in 'The Testaments,'" executive producer Warren Littlefield tells The Hollywood Reporter about the expectations around their Gilead sequel series, which he says needs at least three seasons to tell this story.
